submitted.rationale: BiVO4 (Bi:V = 1:1) is the known visible-light photoanode phase in this system. I used all three merit measurements around 1:1. Index 11 (Bi0.466 V0.534) gave the highest photocurrent, 21.7 µA. The slightly Bi-rich index 8 dropped about 100× to 0.16 µA. The more V-rich index 13 fell to 15.1 µA, so the optimum sits at a slight V excess near index 11.

rejected.reason: Measured 0.16 µA, about 100× lower. Bi-rich films likely contain Bi-rich vanadate or Bi2O3 phases that perform poorly.
Measured 15.1 µA, below index 11. Adding more V lowers photocurrent.
Not measured. These are far from BiVO4 stoichiometry, and the measured trend falls off on both sides of index 11.
